[yellow bold]-- STATE MACHINE WARNING -- main.volt:4[/yellow bold]

State `idle` in machine `m` has no outgoing transitions (dead-end state).

 [dim]3 |[/dim] machine m {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     state idle { }
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]          ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Add a transition or mark with @terminal if intentional.[/cyan]
